text:
Theo: heads-up — onboarding sample app just created two billing records for one request. Using Node SDK `client.admin.createBilling(...)`. curl only shows one. Anyone seen dup charges?
Priya: ouch. paste the SDK call + curl?
Theo: SDK call (simplified):
```js
await client.admin.createBilling({ projectId: 'p-xyz', amount: 1000 })
```
Curl that behaves (single record):
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/billing \
  -d '{"projectId":"p-xyz","amount":1000}'
```
Leah: do we have request traces?
Theo: yes. Backend shows two POST arrivals ~120ms apart. SDK logs show an automatic retry: `retrying request (attempt 2) after network error` even though first request got a 202 accepted.
Priya: ah that sounds like our retry-config change in sdk-core 2.1.0 — it retries on network errors and 5xx, and by default also retries on idempotency failures unless route metadata marks it non-idempotent. We recently added optimistic retry to improve latency SLOs.
Dan: but createBilling is not idempotent — server accepts 202 and processes, so a retry causes duplicate side-effects. Should have been in the non-retriable list.
infra-bot: deploybot: PR #4012 merged to api-service: tighten schema validation and add idempotency metadata.
sdk-bot: Created issue #3678 — "node-sdk: non-idempotent admin.createBilling retried by default causing duplicate records". Linked traces.
Leah: quick mitigation: SDK patch to respect `x-server-idempotency-key` header or add route-level metadata `retry: false` for admin.billing.create. Also add integration test that asserts no retry for POST /admin/billing.
Priya: workaround for sampleapp: pass explicit option `client.admin.createBilling(..., { retry: { retries: 0 } })` or include an idempotency key header.
Theo: adding idempotency key fixed onboarding locally. Thanks.
Dan: separate but related: while investigating I noticed the JS client doesn't expose `admin.getBilling` (the REST route exists). The generated SDK method is named `fetch_billing` in the client which maps to `/v1/admin/get-billing` (404). Looks like codegen mapping changed dash/case rules.
Priya: ugh — two separate parity regressions (retry semantics + endpoint name mapping). We'll need a patch for codegen and the retry defaults.
Leah: I'll open two PRs: one to mark createBilling non-retriable and add idempotency header support, another to fix codegen naming for admin/getBilling.
sdk-bot: Created PRs #790 and #791 in sdk repo and attached unit tests.
Theo: great. Can we also add an e2e that runs sampleapp onboarding in CI to catch these from the start? This was painful for the new customer run.
Priya: agree — adding a lightweight sampleapp smoke job on merges to main.
Theo: thanks folks — workaround applied and I've notified support to pause related onboarding runs until patches land. :+1:
